title: Generating proteins with computationally predicted functions and multiple states via multimodal diffusion
zh_title: 多模态扩散模型ProDiT生成具预测功能与多状态蛋白质
summary: ProDiT统一序列与结构建模，在1.28亿蛋白上训练，可大规模生成计算预测保留活性/结合位点基序、并能条件化于多种分子功能与多状态的蛋白。
key_points: 统一序列与结构范式的多模态扩散模型
训练集覆盖1.28亿蛋白序列、结构与注释
功能与多状态条件生成，功能仅为计算预测
reason: 同行评审、亿级蛋白规模的新生成方法，但功能均为计算预测，未见湿实验验证。
abstract: Jing et al. present ProDiT, a multimodal diffusion model that generates diverse, functionally conditioned proteins, including multistate proteins, expanding capabilities beyond existing generative protein design methods. Generating proteins with the full diversity and complexity of functions found in nature is a grand challenge in protein design. Here we present protein diffusion transformer (ProDiT), a multimodal diffusion model that unifies sequence and structure modelling paradigms to enable the generation of proteins with computationally predicted functions at scale. Trained on sequences, three-dimensional structures and annotations for 128 million proteins across the evolutionary landscape, ProDiT generates diverse, novel proteins that are computationally predicted to preserve known active- and binding-site motifs and can be conditioned on a wide range of molecular functions, spanning 463 Gene Ontology terms. We introduce a diffusion sampling protocol to design proteins with multiple functional states, and illustrate this protocol by computationally scaffolding enzymatic active sites from carbonic anhydrase and lysozyme such that they are predicted to be deactivated by a calcium effector. Our results showcase the capacity of ProDiT to satisfy design specifications inaccessible to existing generative models, thereby expanding the protein design toolkit.
zh_abstract: Jing 等介绍了 ProDiT，一种多模态扩散模型，可生成多样化的、以功能为条件的蛋白质，包括多状态蛋白质，从而将能力扩展到现有生成式蛋白质设计方法之外。生成具有自然界中所见全部多样性和复杂功能的蛋白质是蛋白质设计中的一项重大挑战。在此，我们提出蛋白质扩散变换器（protein diffusion transformer，ProDiT），一种多模态扩散模型，它统一了序列和结构建模范式，从而能够大规模生成具有计算预测功能的蛋白质。ProDiT 在跨越进化景观的 1.28 亿种蛋白质的序列、三维结构和注释上训练，生成多样化的新型蛋白质；这些蛋白质经计算预测可保留已知的活性位点和结合位点基序，并且可以以广泛的分子功能为条件，涵盖 463 个基因本体（Gene Ontology）术语。我们引入一种扩散采样协议来设计具有多种功能状态的蛋白质，并通过计算支架化（computationally scaffolding）碳酸酐酶（carbonic anhydrase）和溶菌酶（lysozyme）的酶活性位点来说明该协议，使这些活性位点被预测可被钙效应物（calcium effector）失活。我们的结果展示了 ProDiT 满足现有生成模型无法达到的设计规范的能力，从而扩展了蛋白质设计工具箱。

title: Safety and accuracy diverge across deployment conditions in clinical large language models
zh_title: 临床大模型安全性与准确性随部署条件分化
summary: npj Digital Medicine 研究提出SaFE-Scale，在200题影像基准上评测34个本地大模型于6种部署条件下的安全性与准确性。
key_points: 构建RadSaFE-200影像选择题基准，含冲突证据标注
评测34个本地大模型、6种部署条件
准确率提升不等同于安全性提升
reason: 同行评审、新基准并系统评测34模型6种部署条件，属重要档
abstract: Clinical large language models (LLMs) are commonly scaled by increasing model size, context length, retrieval complexity, or inference-time compute, on the assumption that higher accuracy implies safer behavior. In medicine, where a few confident or evidence-contradicting errors can outweigh average performance, this assumption may be incomplete. We introduce Safety-Focused Evaluation of Scaling (SaFE-Scale) and instantiate it on RadSaFE-200, a 200-question text-based radiology multiple-choice benchmark with clinician-defined clean evidence, conflict evidence, and option-level labels for high-risk error, unsafe answer, and evidence contradiction. Thirty-four local LLMs were evaluated across six deployment conditions spanning closed-book, evidence-grounded, standard and agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and max-context prompting. Clean clinician-written evidence, used as an upper-bound, produced the strongest joint gain, raising mean accuracy from 73.5% to 94.1% and reducing high-risk error from 12.0% to 2.6% and dangerous overconfidence from 8.0% to 1.6%. Standard and agentic RAG, max-context prompting, and inference-time compute improved selected metrics but did not reproduce this safety profile. Clinically consequential errors concentrated in a small subset of questions, and variance decomposition placed deployment condition above model family on every safety metric. Within this evaluation, clinical LLM safety did not track accuracy scaling but emerged as a deployment-level property.
zh_abstract: 临床大语言模型（LLMs）通常通过增加模型规模、上下文长度、检索复杂性或推理时计算量来扩展，其假设是更高的准确性意味着更安全的行为。在医学中，少数自信的错误或与证据相矛盾的错误可能比平均性能更有分量，因此这一假设可能并不完整。我们提出以安全性为重点的扩展评估（Safety-Focused Evaluation of Scaling, SaFE-Scale），并在RadSaFE-200上实例化；RadSaFE-200是一个包含200个问题的基于文本的放射学多项选择基准，具有临床医生定义的干净证据、冲突证据，以及针对高风险错误、不安全答案和证据矛盾的选项级标签。在六种部署条件下评估了34个本地LLM，涵盖闭卷、有证据依据、标准与智能体式检索增强生成（RAG）以及最大上下文提示。作为上限使用的、由临床医生撰写的干净证据产生了最强的联合增益，将平均准确率从73.5%提高到94.1%，并将高风险错误从12.0%降至2.6%，将危险过度自信从8.0%降至1.6%。标准与智能体式RAG、最大上下文提示以及推理时计算改善了部分选定指标，但未能重现这一安全性特征。具有临床后果的错误集中在一小部分问题上，并且方差分解显示，在每项安全性指标上，部署条件的解释度均高于模型家族。在此评估中，临床LLM安全性并未随准确性扩展而同步变化，而是表现为一种部署层面的属性。

title: Risk governance for generative AI mental health support: a multi-turn safety architecture
zh_title: 生成式AI心理健康支持的风险治理架构
summary: npj Digital Medicine 提出模型外挂的多轮风险治理架构，结合情境风险检测与协议化回应生成。
key_points: 提升临床医生偏好的升级回应25.6–59.2个百分点
风险检测敏感度0.92、特异度0.85
仅在基于真实叙事的合成对话上评估
reason: 同行评审新方法且跨两个模型评估，但仅合成对话、无临床外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for mental health support despite lacking mechanisms to safely govern evolving risk. Existing safety approaches primarily detect risk but rarely shape how models respond as conversational risk unfolds. We developed a portable, model-external safety governance architecture that combines contextual risk detection, reasoning-based verification, and protocol-guided response generation for multi-turn mental health interactions. Using synthetic conversations grounded in real-world mental health narratives, the architecture’s performance was assessed with GPT-5-chat and Qwen3.5-27B, increasing clinician-preferred escalation responses by 25.6–59.2 pp, while achieving high risk detection performance (specificity: 0.85 (95%CI: 0.78;0.91), sensitivity: 0.92 (95%CI: 0.89;0.95)). Performance remained stable across conversation length and across models (proprietary and open-source), with preliminary evidence showing that rapport and connection were preserved. These findings demonstrate that clinically-grounded governance can extend beyond risk detection to improve how LLMs manage evolving mental health risk, providing a framework for scalable safety governance.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于心理健康支持，尽管缺乏对不断演变的风险进行安全治理的机制。现有安全方法主要检测风险，但很少塑造模型随着对话风险展开而作出响应的方式。我们开发了一种可移植的、模型外部的安全治理架构，将情境风险检测、基于推理的验证和协议引导的回复生成相结合，用于多轮心理健康交互。使用以真实世界心理健康叙事为基础的合成对话，采用GPT-5-chat和Qwen3.5-27B评估该架构的性能，使临床医生偏好的升级响应增加了25.6–59.2个百分点，同时实现了高风险检测性能（特异性：0.85（95%CI：0.78；0.91），敏感性：0.92（95%CI：0.89；0.95））。其性能在不同对话长度以及不同模型（专有和开源）之间保持稳定，初步证据显示融洽关系和连接感得以保留。这些发现表明，以临床为基础的治理可以超越风险检测，改善LLMs管理不断演变心理健康风险的方式，为可扩展的安全治理提供框架。

title: AI-integrated versus Standard Mammography Screening Pathways: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis of Diagnostic Accuracy.

summary: 该系统综述纳入38项研究、逾420万例数据，用贝叶斯网状Meta分析比较AI整合与标准乳腺X线筛查路径的诊断准确性。

abstract: [Radiology. Imaging cancer] Purpose To compare the diagnostic accuracy of artificial intelligence (AI)-integrated and standard mammography screening pathways for breast cancer detection using Bayesian network meta-analysis. Materials and Methods This prospectively registered review searched PubMed, Embase, and Web of Science through March 20, 2026, for diagnostic accuracy studies comparing two or more human-only or AI-integrated screening pathways using digital mammography or tomosynthesis. Bayesian bivariate random-effects network meta-analyses were fitted to a primary four-node and a secondary six-node network; risk of bias was assessed using the Quality Assessment of Diagnostic Accuracy Studies 3 (QUADAS-3) and QUADAS-C tools, and certainty was graded using the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation approach. Results Thirty-eight studies, with more than 4.2 million examinations, were included. In the primary digital mammography network (15 studies), AI as an independent reader (sensitivity, 78.9%; specificity, 95.8%) performed similarly to double human reading (sensitivity, 77.7%; specificity, 96.2%). In the secondary network, AI reader assistance had the highest sensitivity (86.8%) and AI triage had the highest specificity (96.4%). Per 10 000 screened (prevalence, 0.8%), AI reader assistance detected nine more cancers than single human reading (69 vs 60), with 77 additional false-positive recalls (558 vs 481); AI triage had 27% fewer false-positive recalls than single human reading (353 vs 481), with the same cancer detection as double human reading (64 vs 64). Stand-alone AI had the lowest specificity (93.0%) and the most false-positive recalls (n = 694). Rankings are hypothesis-generating: Top-ranked pathways had overlapping credible intervals. Conclusion In this synthesis, AI reader assistance was associated with the highest cancer detection and AI triage with the lowest false-positive recall; stand-alone AI was not supported as a primary screening strategy in settings with existing radiologist capacity. Keywords: Artificial Intelligence, Breast Cancer Screening, Diagnostic Test Accuracy, Deep Learning, Digital Mammography, Mammography, Network Meta-Analysis, Screening Pathway, Computer-aided Diagnosis Systematic review registration no. Imaging Cancer] 【目的】使用贝叶斯网络荟萃分析比较人工智能（AI）整合与标准乳腺X线摄影筛查路径对乳腺癌检测的诊断准确性。【材料与方法】这项前瞻性注册的综述检索了PubMed、Embase和Web of Science，截至2026年3月20日，纳入使用数字乳腺X线摄影或断层合成比较两种或以上仅人工或AI整合筛查路径的诊断准确性研究。贝叶斯双变量随机效应网络荟萃分析分别拟合主要四节点网络和次要六节点网络；使用诊断准确性研究质量评估3（QUADAS-3）和QUADAS-C工具评估偏倚风险，并使用推荐分级的评估、制定与评价（GRADE）方法对证据确定性进行分级。【结果】共纳入38项研究，包含超过420万次检查。在主要数字乳腺X线摄影网络（15项研究）中，AI作为独立阅片者（敏感性78.9%；特异性95.8%）的表现与双人阅片（敏感性77.7%；特异性96.2%）相似。在次要网络中，AI辅助阅片者具有最高敏感性（86.8%），AI分诊具有最高特异性（96.4%）。每10 000名筛查者（患病率0.8%），AI辅助阅片者比单人阅片多检出9例癌症（69 vs 60），并多出77例假阳性召回（558 vs 481）；AI分诊的假阳性召回比单人阅片少27%（353 vs 481），癌症检出与双人阅片相同（64 vs 64）。独立AI具有最低特异性（93.0%）和最多假阳性召回（n = 694）。排名具有假设生成性质：排名最高的路径可信区间重叠。【结论】在本综合中，AI辅助阅片者与最高癌症检出相关，AI分诊与最低假阳性召回相关；在已有放射科医师能力的机构中，不支持将独立AI作为主要筛查策略。关键词：人工智能、乳腺癌筛查、诊断试验准确性、深度学习、数字乳腺X线摄影、乳腺X线摄影、网络荟萃分析、筛查路径、计算机辅助诊断。系统综述注册号：INPLASY202630080。本文补充材料可获取。© RSNA, 2026。

title: Clinical AI agents require oversight beyond answer accuracy
zh_title: 临床AI智能体需超越答案准确性的监督
summary: 观点文章认为临床AI智能体可跨步骤执行任务，监督应考察其目标、叙事、工具、不确定性与停止条件，而非仅看答案是否正确。
key_points: 智能体跨多步骤执行，安全风险随之变化
错误「工作叙事」可沿工具与任务传导

reason: 观点/述评类按上限6分；提出智能体监督框架有议题价值，但无实证数据。
abstract: Clinical AI agents can carry tasks across steps. This changes the safety problem. The question is not only whether an AI system gives a correct response, but what working narrative it carries into action. A wrong narrative can move through tools, tasks, and care. Clinical oversight should examine the agent’s goal, narrative, tools, uncertainty, and stopping conditions before it enters workflow.
zh_abstract: 临床 AI 智能体（clinical AI agents）可以跨步骤承载任务。这改变了安全问题。问题不仅在于 AI 系统是否给出正确回应，还在于它把什么样的工作叙事（working narrative）带入行动。错误的叙事可能通过工具、任务和照护流程传播。临床监督应在智能体进入工作流程之前，审查其目标、叙事、工具、不确定性以及停止条件。

title: Sports agnostic whole body sweat rate prediction using consumer-grade wearables and biophysics-guided machine learning

summary: 利用可穿戴加速度与心率数据配合热平衡方程预测全身出汗率，独立验证集合并误差约0.03 L/h。
key_points: 147名志愿者、234次试验数据
覆盖篮球、足球、网球、跑步四项运动

abstract: This manuscript describes a novel consumer-grade wearable approach, leveraging a self-supervised learning architecture for sports agnostic (basketball, running, soccer, and tennis) activity intensity features, that integrates with a heat balance approach to predict whole-body sweating rate. We collected whole-body sweating rates and analyzed data from 234 trials from 147 volunteers. Wet-bulb globe temperature ranged from 11 to 35 ^oC. Wearable triaxial accelerometry and chest-strap heart rate data were processed through a pretrained neural network to predict metabolic components for heat balance equations. For the independent validation set, the mean absolute error for predicted whole-body sweating rate was 0.08 L/h for basketball, 0.17 L/h for soccer, 0.00 L/h for tennis, 0.03 L/h for running with 0.03 L/h for all sports combined. The accounted-for variance ( R ^2) for the whole-body sweating rate predictions were 0.76 for basketball, 0.73 for soccer, 0.82 for tennis, 0.94 for running and 0.79 for all sports combined. This study produced the following novel advancements: (1) first integration of wearable-derived activity features with a heat balance equation for sweat prediction; (2) first validated sport-agnostic wearable sweat prediction approach; and (3) first wearable method enabling a priori hydration management planning for exercise-heat stress conditions.
zh_abstract: 本手稿描述了一种新型消费级可穿戴方法，利用自监督学习架构提取与运动项目无关（篮球、跑步、足球和网球）的活动强度特征，并与热平衡方法整合以预测全身出汗率。我们收集了全身出汗率并分析了来自147名志愿者的234次试验数据。湿球黑球温度范围为11至35 °C。可穿戴三轴加速度计和胸带心率数据通过预训练神经网络处理，以预测热平衡方程的代谢组分。对于独立验证集，预测全身出汗率的平均绝对误差为：篮球0.08 L/h，足球0.17 L/h，网球0.00 L/h，跑步0.03 L/h，所有运动合并为0.03 L/h。全身出汗率预测的解释方差（R^2）为：篮球0.76，足球0.73，网球0.82，跑步0.94，所有运动合并0.79。本研究产生了以下新进展：（1）首次将可穿戴设备衍生的活动特征与热平衡方程整合用于出汗预测；（2）首次验证了与运动项目无关的可穿戴出汗预测方法；（3）首次提供可穿戴方法，能够在运动-热应激条件下实现先验的水化管理计划。

title: Heart Rate Variability Estimation from 3D Seismocardiography: A Deep Learning Approach with a Large-Scale Dataset.
zh_title: 基于三轴心震图的大规模深度学习心率变异性估计
summary: 同行评审研究用三通道一维U-Net从短时静息心震图检测心搏时点以估计HRV，训练样本超5500人并在独立测试集评估。

abstract: [Physiological measurement] Heart rate variability (HRV) is a widely used non-invasive marker of autonomic nervous system regulation, with applications in stress assessment, recovery monitoring, and cardiovascular health evaluation. With the increasing use of wearable technologies, seismocardiography (SCG) has emerged as a promising modality for estimating resting HRV from cardiac mechanical activity. However, large-scale validation of deep learning-based HRV estimation from wearable triaxial SCG remains limited. This study aimed to develop and evaluate a deep learning-based framework for estimating HRV from triaxial SCG signals using a large-scale, real-world resting-state wearable dataset. A three-channel 1D U-Net was trained to detect heartbeat timing from short-term resting SCG recordings. The model was developed using data from over 5,500 subjects and evaluated on an independent test cohort of 940 individuals. Reference heartbeat timing was derived from ECG-based RR intervals and used to generate Gaussian target masks for model training. Inter-beat intervals (IBIs) estimated from SCG-derived beat timings were subsequently used to compute time-domain, frequency-domain, Poincaré plot, and non-linear HRV metrics. The proposed framework classified 93.8% of recordings as suitable for HRV analysis. For these, SCG-derived IBIs showed excellent agreement with reference RR intervals (r = 0.981, bias = 0.190 ms). Time-domain HRV metrics demonstrated strong correlations with reference values across recording effective durations of 30-300 s (r = 0.988-0.999), whereas frequency-domain and nonlinear HRV metrics, evaluated using recordings with an effective duration exceeding 120 s, also showed high correlations (r = 0.843-0.995). These findings demonstrate that HRV estimation from resting SCG is feasible at scale, with particularly strong performance for time-domain and Poincaré plot metrics. By achieving robust beat timing and HRV agreement in a real-world resting cohort, the proposed framework advances SCG as a practical non-invasive alternative or complement to ECG-based HRV monitoring.
zh_abstract: 【生理测量】心率变异性（HRV）是自主神经系统调节的一种广泛使用的无创标志物，应用于压力评估、恢复监测和心血管健康评价。随着可穿戴技术的日益使用，心震图（SCG）已成为从心脏机械活动估计静息HRV的一种有前景的方式。然而，基于可穿戴三轴SCG的深度学习HRV估计的大规模验证仍然有限。本研究旨在使用大规模真实世界静息态可穿戴数据集，开发并评估一个从三轴SCG信号估计HRV的深度学习框架。训练了一个三通道一维U-Net，从短期静息SCG记录中检测心搏时序。该模型使用来自超过5,500名受试者的数据开发，并在由940名个体组成的独立测试队列上评估。参考心搏时序由基于ECG的RR间期导出，并用于生成高斯目标掩模以进行模型训练。随后，从SCG导出的心搏时序估计的搏间间期（IBI）被用于计算时域、频域、Poincaré图和非线性HRV指标。所提出的框架将93.8%的记录分类为适合HRV分析。对于这些记录，SCG导出的IBI与参考RR间期显示出极好的一致性（r = 0.981，偏差 = 0.190 ms）。时域HRV指标在30–300 s的记录有效时长范围内与参考值显示出强相关性（r = 0.988–0.999），而频域和非线性HRV指标在使用有效时长超过120 s的记录评估时也显示出高相关性（r = 0.843–0.995）。这些发现表明，从静息SCG估计HRV在大规模上是可行的，尤其是时域和Poincaré图指标性能特别强。通过在真实世界静息队列中实现稳健的心搏时序和HRV一致性，所提出的框架推进了SCG作为一种实用的无创替代或补充基于ECG的HRV监测的手段。

abstract: Longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) from primary care are scarce in low- and middle-income countries, and few have been made available to researchers in Latin America. We present DiabetIA, a longitudinal dataset derived from the primary care records of the Mexican Institute of Social Security (IMSS). The first release comprises 136,674 adults followed in six IMSS family medicine units in the state of Michoacan between 2005 and 2020, with more than 3.2 million visits summarized in 414,770 two-year windows with at least one visit. Each window includes demographics, ICD-10 diagnoses, anthropometry, vital signs, laboratory results and prescriptions, and type 2 diabetes diagnoses in the following year as prediction targets. At baseline, 24.4% of the patients had type 2 diabetes, 37.1% hypertension and 32.3% obesity. Technical validation assessed completeness, plausibility, consistency, temporal coverage and agreement with a state health survey. DiabetIA is freely available for download to support research on chronic disease trajectories and prediction in an underrepresented population.

abstract: [Methods of information in medicine] Objectives Large language models are increasingly used in evidence synthesis, but high accuracy among returned values may coexist with consequential omissions. We evaluated a stateless, source-grounded artificial intelligence (AI) workflow for extracting data from primary randomized-trial reports and reconstructing meta-analyses. Methods The fixed corpus comprised 15 randomized trials from a published review of regional anesthesia for pediatric cardiac surgery. For each trial report, one stateless extraction attempt was made with GPT-5.6-sol through the application programming interface (API), using the primary-report PDF and a frozen prompt and schema. No review material was supplied at inference time. A transport-only retry was permitted only when no scientific output had been produced. The reference standard was a manually source-verified universe of target-positive cells. Outcomes included composite reconstruction accuracy, precision, completeness, source support, rescue performance, and pooled-estimate reconstruction. Results Thirteen primary calls produced contract-valid outputs; two completed outputs failed the support contract. Of 1,657 evaluable cells, 821 satisfied the preregistered composite requirement for exact content and adequate source support (49.55%). Among 897 positive claims, 892 were content-exact (99.44%), 823 had adequate support (91.75%), and 821 met both criteria (protocol-composite precision 91.53%). Completeness was 54.13%, and 760 source-present cells were omitted. Effect direction agreed in all 11 syntheses estimable from both input sets, but only eight used the same study set; four of 15 source-based syntheses were not estimable from AI inputs. Both failed trials produced a valid first rescue output, with 173 of 284 cells exact and supported (60.92%). Conclusions Returned positive claims were usually content-exact, but only 91.53% met the full content-and-support criterion and the workflow recovered only about half of source-present cells. These findings support stateless extraction as human-verified assistance with explicit auditing of omissions and source support, rather than as autonomous systematic-review extraction.
zh_abstract: 《Methods of Information in Medicine》【目的】大语言模型越来越多地用于证据合成，但返回数值的高准确性可能与有后果的遗漏并存。我们评估了一种无状态、基于来源的人工智能（AI）工作流程，用于从原始随机试验报告中提取数据并重建荟萃分析。【方法】固定语料库由一项已发表的儿童心脏手术区域麻醉综述中的 15 项随机试验组成。对于每份试验报告，通过应用程序编程接口（API）使用 GPT-5.6-sol 进行一次无状态提取尝试，使用原始报告 PDF 以及冻结的提示词和模式。推断时未提供任何综述材料。仅当未产生任何科学输出时，才允许仅因传输问题而重试。参考标准为经人工来源核验的目标阳性单元格全集。结局包括复合重建准确性、精确率、完整性、来源支持、补救性能和合并估计重建。【结果】13 次主要调用产生了契约有效输出；2 个已完成输出未通过支持契约。在 1,657 个可评估单元格中，821 个满足预注册的复合要求，即内容精确且来源支持充分（49.55%）。在 897 条阳性声明中，892 条内容精确（99.44%），823 条有充分支持（91.75%），821 条同时满足两项标准（方案复合精确率 91.53%）。完整性为 54.13%，有 760 个来源中存在的单元格被遗漏。在两组输入集均可估计的 11 项合成中，效应方向一致，但仅 8 项使用了相同的研究集；15 项基于来源的合成中有 4 项无法从 AI 输入估计。两个失败试验均在首次补救输出中产生了有效输出，284 个单元格中有 173 个内容精确且获得支持（60.92%）。【结论】返回的阳性声明通常内容精确，但仅 91.53% 满足完整的内容与支持标准，且该工作流程仅回收了约一半的来源中存在的单元格。这些发现支持将无状态提取作为经人工核验的辅助手段，并对遗漏和来源支持进行明确审计，而不是作为自主的系统综述提取。

abstract: [Journal of clinical nursing] To explore how clinical nurses integrate generative artificial intelligence into nursing work, focusing on task support, perceived ability to verify outputs and professional responsibility. GenAI is increasingly used in nursing, but little is known about how nurses perceive their ability to verify outputs when task barriers are reduced, especially in evidence-sensitive or patient-related tasks. Between October and December 2025, a qualitative descriptive study was conducted in four tertiary hospitals in Nantong, China. Clinical nurses with experience of using GenAI were recruited using purposive maximum-variation sampling. Data were collected through individual semi-structured interviews and analysed using inductive thematic analysis. Data collection and analysis were conducted concurrently, with saturation assessed after 21 interviews and confirmed by one additional interview. Twenty-two clinical nurses were interviewed. Three themes and six subthemes were identified: (1) broadening GenAI use across nursing tasks, including progression from routine drafting to diverse nursing tasks and lowering task barriers; (2) the completion-verification gap, encompassing efficiency and learning support alongside superficial understanding and premature confidence; and (3) risk-calibrated integration, involving risk-based verification, retained professional responsibility and organisational safeguards. GenAI facilitated engagement with information-intensive and unfamiliar nursing tasks. However, easier task completion did not necessarily resolve perceived difficulties in identifying omissions, fabricated information or inappropriate recommendations. Safe integration therefore requires nurses to calibrate verification according to task risk, retain responsibility for final decisions and have access to organisational safeguards that support traceable and accountable use. Safe GenAI use in nursing requires risk-based verification, retained professional accountability and appropriate organisational safeguards. No patients or members of the public were involved because this study focused on clinical nurses' professional experiences.
zh_abstract: [Journal of Clinical Nursing] 探讨临床护士如何将生成式人工智能（GenAI）整合到护理工作中，重点关注任务支持、感知到的验证输出能力以及职业责任。GenAI 在护理中的使用日益增多，但关于当任务障碍降低时护士如何看待自身验证输出的能力，尤其是证据敏感或患者相关任务，知之甚少。2025年10月至12月，在中国南通四家三级医院开展了一项定性描述性研究。采用目的性最大变异抽样招募有使用 GenAI 经验的临床护士。通过个体半结构化访谈收集数据，并采用归纳式主题分析进行分析。数据收集与分析同时进行，在21次访谈后评估饱和，并通过额外1次访谈确认。共访谈22名临床护士。识别出3个主题和6个亚主题：（1）拓宽 GenAI 在护理任务中的使用，包括从常规起草进展到多样化护理任务以及降低任务障碍；（2）完成与验证之间的差距，涵盖效率和学习支持，同时伴随浅层理解和过早信心；（3）风险校准的整合，涉及基于风险的验证、保留职业责任以及组织保障。GenAI 促进了护士参与信息密集型和不熟悉的护理任务。然而，更容易完成任务未必能解决在识别遗漏、捏造信息或不当建议方面感知到的困难。因此，安全整合要求护士根据任务风险校准验证、保留对最终决策的责任，并能获得支持可追溯和可问责使用的组织保障。护理中安全使用 GenAI 需要基于风险的验证、保留职业问责以及适当的组织保障。未涉及患者或公众成员，因为本研究聚焦于临床护士的职业经历。

abstract: [Acta ophthalmologica] To investigate how artificial intelligence (AI) systems detect referable diabetic retinopathy (DR) from retinal photographs by analysing heatmap patterns and determining their overlap with DR features. Fifty-four AI systems were developed using 27 backbone architectures, with each implemented as both binary-referable and multi-class grading models based on the International Clinical Diabetic Retinopathy (ICDR) grading scale. Models were trained on DDR, BRSET and Kaggle datasets. After training, each model analysed 749 images with DR feature annotations, with Grad-CAM, Integrated Gradients, LIME and SHAP heatmaps generated and compared to pixel-level annotations of microaneurysms, haemorrhages, exudates, cotton wool spots, venous beading, intraretinal microvascular abnormalities and neovascularisation. All models achieved acceptable predictive performance (AUROC >0.8 for most architectures). Heatmap analysis revealed consistent attention to the central and temporal macular region. Exudates and cotton wool spots were highlighted most frequently by the heatmaps, with venous beading and neovascularisation at the disc showing poor overall coverage for binary referable classifiers. Models grading per the ICDR scale demonstrated higher coverage for all features. Substantial variability was observed between architectures, suggesting different feature detection capabilities. Interestingly, the heatmap analysis indicated that the models may be using different features to the ICDR grading scale definitions. AI models do not uniformly correlate with all DR features when detecting referable DR, limiting their predictive performance in unusual presentations. Heatmap aggregation analysis provides a scalable method for analysing model behaviour, allowing strengths and weaknesses to be assessed. These findings may help improve clinicians' trust and acceptance of AI.

abstract: Alcohol use disorder (AUD) is often under-documented in patients with cirrhosis, which delays treatment. Expert chart review of clinical notes can identify under-documented AUD, but is not scalable. We propose MedDx, an open-weight, training-free, and engine-agnostic language model, to phenotype AUD using clinical notes in patients with cirrhosis. We benchmarked MedDx on a 485-patient study cohort sampled from the 14,406-patient Indiana Cirrhosis Registry, using a chart-review-based reference as ground truth. MedDx agreed with the ground truth at three-class Cohen's {kappa} 0.92, against 0.67 for the AUD diagnosis code. It agreed with one hepatologist at 0.85 on all 485 charts and with a second at 0.82 on 186 charts, on which the two hepatologists agreed at 0.87. Weighted to the registry, its sensitivity was 98% and specificity 94%, against 63% and 96% for the AUD diagnosis code, and 61% of an estimated 6,223 patients with AUD had no AUD diagnosis by the first cirrhosis diagnosis. MedDx is openly available as an off-the-shelf, equitable, and auditable tool to identify AUD.

分人类、原始描述AI、改写描述AI三组各9次
以一致性指标衡量AI复现的可重复性
reason: 有明确新方法与人机对照，但为未经同行评审预印本，属中档
abstract: Objective: Previously, nine expert teams given a published study and identical code sets produced nine substantially different cohorts, prompting the conclusion that analytic code cannot be reliably generated from natural-language description. We tested whether an artificial intelligence (AI) agent, given that same description, reproduces a cohort definition more faithfully and consistently than those teams. Materials and Methods: Against a claims database of 35.9 million patients, we executed 27 independent reproductions of that published glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist cohort definition: the nine published human definitions re-implemented deterministically (Arm A); nine independent AI agent runs given the source paper as published (Arm B); and nine given a rewrite that removed its internal contradictions (Arm C). All arms received identical frozen code sets. Agreement with a reference cohort was quantified by the Jaccard index. Results: Agents in Arm B achieved a median Jaccard index of 0.450 versus 0.259 for the human definitions, median pairwise agreement of 0.492 versus 0.149, and a 5.06-fold versus 32.0-fold size spread. Agent variation resolved almost entirely onto two criteria reported differently in the source main text and supplement. In Arm C, median agreement and median pairwise agreement both reached 1.000. Discussion: Changing only the analyst strongly trended towards improvement in fidelity, with every agent run more self-consistent than every human team. Changing the specification resulted in exact fidelity and self-consistency. Irreproducibility arose from both specification quality and inter-analyst variation. Conclusion: AI agents were more consistent than human teams when translating published natural-language descriptions into code.
zh_abstract: 【目的】此前，九个专家团队在获得同一项已发表研究和相同代码集的情况下，产生了九个显著不同的队列，这促使人们得出结论：分析代码无法从自然语言描述中可靠生成。我们测试了在给定相同描述的情况下，人工智能（AI）智能体是否能比这些团队更忠实、更一致地复现队列定义。【材料与方法】基于包含3590万患者的理赔数据库，我们对该已发表的胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂队列定义执行了27次独立复现：将九个已发表的人工定义以确定性方式重新实现（A组）；九次独立的AI智能体运行，输入为按原样发表的源论文（B组）；以及九次输入为移除其内部矛盾后的改写版本（C组）。所有组均获得相同的冻结代码集。与参考队列的一致性通过Jaccard指数进行量化。【结果】B组智能体达到的中位Jaccard指数为0.450，而人工定义为0.259；中位两两一致性为0.492，而人工定义为0.149；规模差异倍数为5.06倍，而人工定义为32.0倍。智能体间的变异几乎完全归结于源论文正文与补充材料中报告方式不同的两项标准。在C组中，中位一致性和中位两两一致性均达到1.000。【讨论】仅改变分析者强烈趋向于保真度改善，每一次智能体运行都比每一个人类团队更自一致。改变规范则带来了精确的保真度和自一致性。不可重复性既源于规范质量，也源于分析者间变异。【结论】在将已发表的自然语言描述转化为代码时，AI智能体比人类团队更一致。

title: How many large language models does title-abstract screening need? Theory, two replications and an evaluation at real prevalence

summary: 预印本用相关投票模型估计LLM筛选集成所需模型数，并在多个Cochrane与基准数据集上复现验证。
key_points: 11个LLM盲评13个SYNERGY综述记录

abstract: Background and Objectives: Researchers increasingly combine large language models (LLMs) to screen titles and abstracts, assuming that more models make screening safer. We estimated how many models a screening ensemble needs, given correlated errors, and tested the answer on independent reviews and at real prevalence. Methods: We modelled correlated votes with a beta-binomial model and estimated, by bootstrap, the smallest ensemble capturing 95% of the net-benefit gain attainable over the best single model, accounting for human reading time and machine cost. Eleven LLMs from four developers voted blind on records from 13 SYNERGY reviews (derivation). We tested predictions fixed in advance on 10 and 16 Cochrane reviews from a public screening benchmark (replications) and evaluated a two-voter pipeline with an adjudicator on 11 complete benchmark collections and six reviews published in 2026. Results: Errors on relevant records were correlated (intraclass correlation 0.56 among eight different models; 0.75-0.78 among roles or copies of one model): eight models carried the information of about 1.6 independent ones. In derivation, the best single model, pair and trio reached sensitivities of 0.920, 0.975 and 0.981. Three or fewer models captured 95% of the attainable gain in at least 86%, 88% and 80.8% of bootstrap replicates of every scenario in the derivation set and the two replications, respectively. Six of seven registered predictions held in replication 1 and three of five sealed predictions in replication 2, where a fourth model added 2.1 percentage points to trios on average but 0.3 to the best trio. At real prevalence, the pipeline sent 94 of 96 included studies to human reading in the benchmark collections and 163 of 178 in the 2026 reviews (12.1% of 12,196 records sent to reading); its more sensitive voter alone sent 259 of 274 with 12.0%, at under a quarter of the machine cost. Conclusion: Because LLM errors are correlated, our results suggest two or three well-chosen models may suffice, but this needs deeper exploration in future studies. Which models are combined and how matter as much as how many, and any ensemble should be compared with its best single member.
zh_abstract: 【背景与目的】研究者越来越多地组合使用大语言模型（LLMs）筛选标题和摘要，假设更多模型会使筛选更安全。考虑到误差具有相关性，我们估计了一个筛选模型组合需要多少个模型，并在独立综述和真实患病率下检验了该答案。【方法】我们使用β-二项模型对相关投票建模，并通过bootstrap估计能够捕获相对于最佳单一模型可达到的净获益增量95%的最小模型组合，同时考虑人工阅读时间和机器成本。来自4家开发者的11个LLM对来自13项SYNERGY综述的记录进行盲法投票（推导集）。我们在来自一个公共筛选基准的10项和16项Cochrane综述上检验了预先固定的预测（重复验证），并在11个完整基准合集和2026年发表的6项综述上评估了带裁决者的两投票者流程。【结果】相关记录上的错误具有相关性（八个不同模型之间的组内相关系数为0.56；同一模型的不同角色或副本之间为0.75–0.78）：八个模型携带的信息约相当于1.6个独立模型。在推导集中，最佳单一模型、两模型组合和三模型组合的灵敏度分别达到0.920、0.975和0.981。在推导集及两个重复验证集中，每个情景的bootstrap重复分别至少有86%、88%和80.8%中，三个或更少的模型捕获了可达增益的95%。在重复验证1中，7项注册预测中有6项成立；在重复验证2中，5项封存预测中有3项成立，在该重复验证中，第四个模型平均为三模型组合增加2.1个百分点，但对最佳三模型组合仅增加0.3个百分点。在真实患病率下，该流程在基准合集中将96项纳入研究中的94项送交人工阅读，在2026年综述中将178项中的163项送交人工阅读（12,196条记录中有12.1%被送交阅读）；其更敏感的单个投票者单独将274项中的259项送交阅读，占12.0%，机器成本不到四分之一。【结论】由于LLM错误具有相关性，我们的结果提示两个或三个精心选择的模型可能已经足够，但这需要在未来研究中更深入探索。组合哪些模型以及如何组合，与组合多少个模型同样重要，任何模型组合都应与其最佳单一成员进行比较。

title: A Benchmark for Generative Modeling of High-Dimensional Enzyme Kinetic Parameters of Metabolic Networks
zh_title: 代谢网络高维酶动力学参数生成建模基准
summary: 预印本发布酶动力学参数集生成建模基准，含可行模型数据集与基于动力学稳定性和表型一致性的评估框架，并比较三种架构。
key_points: 提供标注的大肠杆菌动力学可行模型数据集
评估不仅看统计逼真度，还看动力学稳定性与表型一致性

reason: 新基准含数据集与机制化评估框架，但为预印本且开放情况未明
abstract: Large-scale kinetic models predict how metabolism responds to genetic and environmental perturbations, but building them at scale is limited by the scarcity of experimentally determined enzyme kinetic parameters. Generative machine learning has been proposed to address this bottleneck, yet prior work has each introduced a single, bespoke architecture, leaving open which generative paradigm suits this problem and why. We introduce a benchmark suite for generative modeling of high-dimensional enzyme kinetic parameter sets: labeled datasets of kinetically feasible Escherichia coli models paired with a mechanistically grounded evaluation harness that scores generated ensembles on dynamical stability and agreement with experimentally observed phenotypes, rather than statistical realism alone. Using it, we compare three standard architectures at matched capacity, a conditional variational autoencoder, a Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty, and a RealNVP normalizing flow, each under two conditioning schemes (a discrete high/low label and a continuous, graded key-performance-indicator target), across a difficulty ladder from one mutant phenotype to a stringent class of nine reproduced jointly. Two findings stand out. The architectures trace a consistent concentration-exploration trade-off, the VAE concentrating, the flow exploring and extrapolating, the GAN in between, but this ordering is overturned at high stringency by the conditioning scheme: at the joint class, continuous targets reach 33 to 117-fold enrichment over random sampling for every architecture, whereas discrete labels stay at 1.3 to 15-fold. Beyond the comparison, the suite is an accessible, mechanistically validated reference task for groups outside the kinetic-modeling community to benchmark their own generative algorithms.
zh_abstract: 大规模动力学模型可预测代谢如何响应遗传和环境扰动，但大规模构建此类模型受限于实验测定的酶动力学参数稀缺。生成式机器学习已被提出用于解决这一瓶颈，但先前工作各自只引入了一种单一的、定制化的架构，仍未明确哪种生成范式适合该问题及其原因。我们引入一个用于高维酶动力学参数集生成建模的基准测试套件：带标签的动力学可行大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）模型数据集，并配以具有机制依据的评估框架；该框架对生成的集合在动力学稳定性和与实验观察表型的一致性方面进行评分，而非仅依据统计真实性。使用该套件，我们在容量匹配的条件下比较三种标准架构：条件变分自编码器（conditional variational autoencoder）、带梯度惩罚的 Wasserstein GAN（Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty）和 RealNVP 归一化流（RealNVP normalizing flow），每种架构均在两种条件化方案下（离散的高/低标签和连续的、分级的关键绩效指标目标），跨越从单一突变表型到需联合重现的严格九类表型的难度阶梯。有两项发现尤为突出。三种架构呈现出一致的集中-探索权衡：VAE 集中，flow 探索并外推，GAN 介于两者之间；但在高严格度下，这一排序被条件化方案逆转：在联合类别上，对于每种架构，连续目标相对于随机采样达到 33 至 117 倍富集，而离散标签则保持在 1.3 至 15 倍。除比较之外，该套件也是一个易获取、经机制验证的参考任务，可供动力学建模社区之外的研究团队对其自身的生成算法进行基准测试。

title: Confident but misplaced: a model-free ruler for post-translational modification placement by AI structure predictors

summary: 预印本以晶体结构为标尺，评测RareFold、Boltz-2、Chai-1与AlphaFold 3在176个留出翻译后修饰位点上的原子放置准确性及置信度可靠性。
key_points: 从同一位点独立晶体结构构建无模型标尺

abstract: AI structure predictors accept post-translationally modified (PTM) residues, but whether they place the added atoms where crystallography finds them, and whether their confidence reveals when they do not, is unknown. We first built a ruler from experiment alone: independent crystal structures of the same site reproduce the added atoms of oxidised cysteine and methionine to 0.32 [A], the closest pre-cutoff library rotamer lies at 0.41 [A] and a model-free guess at 4.17 [A]. We then predicted 176 hold-out PTM sites, released after every model's training cut-off, with RareFold, Boltz-2, Chai-1 and AlphaFold 3, using identical inputs and thresholds fixed before measurement. On oxidised Cys/Met (up to 34 sites in 25 proteins), the three all-atom models place the matching distal atoms of neighbouring canonical side chains to 0.35-0.38 [A] but the added oxygens at 1.19-1.51 [A]; 29-41 % of placements are wrong by more than 2 [A], as sterically plausible rotamers that the electron density does not support. RareFold misplaces ordinary side chains as well. Across all PTM classes, residue confidence does not flag the failure: at pLDDT [≥] 90, 24-46 % of modified-residue placements are catastrophic, 3.5-5 times the rate for matched canonical atoms. One seed rarely samples the correct rotamer; more seeds sample it more often, yet the models' own ranking does not select it. Methyllysine shows the same gap, whereas for pyridoxal-lysine the models diverge (AlphaFold 3 1.13 [A], Boltz-2 4.96 [A]). A high residue pLDDT at a modified residue therefore does not verify its side chain.
zh_abstract: AI结构预测器可接受翻译后修饰（PTM）残基，但它们是否将新增原子放置在晶体学所发现的位置，以及其置信度是否能揭示未放置正确的情况，尚不清楚。我们首先仅基于实验构建了一把“标尺”：同一位点的独立晶体结构将氧化半胱氨酸和甲硫氨酸的新增原子重现至0.32 Å，最接近的预截断库旋转异构体位于0.41 Å，而无模型猜测为4.17 Å。随后，我们使用RareFold、Boltz-2、Chai-1和AlphaFold 3，在相同输入和测量前固定的阈值下，预测了176个留出PTM位点，这些位点在每个模型的训练截止日期之后发布。对于氧化Cys/Met（25种蛋白质中最多34个位点），三个全原子模型将相邻经典侧链的匹配远端原子放置至0.35–0.38 Å，但将新增氧原子放置至1.19–1.51 Å；29–41%的放置错误超过2 Å，表现为空间上看似合理但电子密度不支持的旋转异构体。RareFold也会错放普通侧链。在所有PTM类别中，残基置信度并不能标示这种失败：在pLDDT ≥ 90时，24–46%的修饰残基放置是灾难性的，是匹配经典原子相应比例的3.5–5倍。单个种子很少采样到正确旋转异构体；更多种子会更频繁地采样到它，但模型自身的排序并未选择它。甲基赖氨酸显示出相同差距，而对于吡哆醛-赖氨酸，模型出现分歧（AlphaFold 3 1.13 Å，Boltz-2 4.96 Å）。因此，修饰残基处的高残基pLDDT并不能验证其侧链。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Shandong University; conditions: AI (Artificial Intelligence), Endoscopy of Stomach (Procedure); type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 371000; status: RECRUITING] This mixed-methods study will include retrospective model development, cross-sectional validation, and prospective clinical validation. The study will generally follow relevant guidelines for AI-based clinical research. 1. Retrospective Model Development Approximately 300,000 gastroscopy examinations from our center will be retrospectively included. Available endoscopic data and related clinical information will be collected for model development and internal validation. Several publicly available gastrointestinal endoscopy datasets will also be included to increase data diversity. These datasets will provide supplementary data for model development and evaluation. The model will broadly support common gastroscopy-related tasks, such as lesion assessment, examination quality evaluation, and report generation. General data cleaning, quality control, and expert review will be conducted when necessary. 2. Cross-sectional Validation Approximately 70,000 gastroscopy examinations from a different time period will be consecutively included for independent validation. The model results will be compared with reference results established according to generally accepted clinical practice. Diagnostic standards will broadly follow relevant clinical guidelines and expert judgment. The purpose of this phase is to assess the model's overall diagnostic performance, report quality, generalizability, and stability using commonly accepted evaluation methods. 3. Prospective Clinical Validation A prospective clinical validation study involving approximately 1,000 patients will be conducted at our center. The model will be integrated into routine clinical practice to provide general assistance to physicians. Its outputs will be used for reference and will not replace physicians' final clinical decisions or signed reports. The study will generally compare clinical workflows with and without AI assistance. It will assess the model's potential effects on work efficiency, workload, clinical usability, and safety under real-world conditions.

abstract: [Clinical oral investigations] Although artificial intelligence has shown promise in detecting dental pathologies on radiographs, integrating these findings into patient-level disease profiles and caries risk stratification remains challenging. This study aimed to address this gap by combining automated radiographic analysis with fuzzy logic. YOLOv11 based models were trained to automatically detect teeth and pathological findings (caries, restorations, missing teeth) in panoramic radiographs. The DMFT (Decayed, Missing, Filled Teeth) score calculated from the detections and a single anamnesis question regarding the patient's previous treatment history were incorporated into a Mamdani-type fuzzy inference system to generate a quantitative risk score and corresponding risk category (low, medium, or high). The developed model was evaluated using clinical panoramic radiographs from 200 patients. The YOLOv11l model achieved a recall of 0.936 in pathology detection. The resulting classifications showed agreement rates of 92.5% and 92.0% with the American Dental Association (ADA) and Caries Management by Risk Assessment (CAMBRA) protocols, respectively. Cohen's kappa values exceeded 0.87. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of integrating radiographic detections and patient information into a structured patient-level assessment. The combination of automated image analysis and fuzzy logic provides a clinical decision-support framework for caries risk stratification based on panoramic radiographs. This approach offers an alternative way to integrate radiographic findings into a structured risk assessment process. The proposed system integrates automated radiographic analysis and risk stratification into routine dental assessment without requiring additional procedures. It can support clinical decision-making and facilitate communication with patients regarding oral health.
zh_abstract: [Clinical oral investigations] 尽管人工智能在检测影像学牙科病变方面已显示出前景，但将这些发现整合到患者层面的疾病画像和龋齿风险分层中仍具挑战性。本研究旨在通过将自动影像学分析与模糊逻辑相结合来弥补这一空白。研究训练了基于 YOLOv11 的模型，以在全景放射片中自动检测牙齿和病理发现（龋齿、修复体、缺失牙）。将从检测结果计算得到的 DMFT（Decayed, Missing, Filled Teeth，龋失补牙数）评分以及一个关于患者既往治疗史的问诊问题纳入 Mamdani 型模糊推理系统，以生成定量风险评分及相应风险类别（低、中或高）。使用 200 名患者的临床全景放射片对开发的模型进行评估。YOLOv11l 模型在病理检测中的召回率为 0.936。所得分类分别与美国牙科协会（American Dental Association, ADA）和龋齿风险评估管理（Caries Management by Risk Assessment, CAMBRA）方案的一致率为 92.5% 和 92.0%。Cohen's kappa 值超过 0.87。这些发现证明了将影像学检测结果和患者信息整合到结构化患者层面评估中的可行性。自动图像分析与模糊逻辑的结合为基于全景放射片的龋齿风险分层提供了临床决策支持框架。该方法提供了一种将影像学发现整合到结构化风险评估流程中的替代方式。所提出的系统将自动影像学分析和风险分层整合到常规牙科评估中，无需额外操作。它可以支持临床决策并促进与患者就口腔健康进行沟通。

summary: 澳新放射学院会员匿名在线调查，以自我决定理论检验使用AI的动机是否调节AI使用频率与职业倦怠的关系。

abstract: [Journal of medical imaging and radiation oncology] Burnout is a major concern across medical professions, with radiologists and radiation oncologists among the most affected. Artificial intelligence (AI) has the potential to reduce burnout by decreasing workload; however, previous research has shown inconsistent associations between AI use and burnout. These relationships may depend on clinicians' motivation for using AI. A 6.5 min anonymous online survey was distributed to members of the Royal Australian and New Zealand College of Radiologists (RANZCR) over a 2 month period (May-July 2025). Measures included demographics and work-related variables (hours, level of training), burnout, AI use (frequency and task type), and motivation to use AI (based on Self-Determination Theory). Motivation was examined as a moderator of the relationship between AI use and burnout. Responses were received from 121 clinicians (90 radiologists, 31 radiation oncologists), including 21 trainees. Clinically significant burnout was reported by 42.1% (51/121) of respondents. Ninety-one (75.2%) respondents reported using AI, primarily for image analysis and interpretation (radiologists) and treatment planning (radiation oncologists). There was no overall significant relationship between AI use and burnout. However, AI use was positively associated with burnout among those reporting lower autonomy in AI use. This relationship was not mediated by need satisfaction or frustration. AI use is common among RANZCR members, and the burnout rate is prevalent. These preliminary findings highlight the potential importance of supporting autonomous motivation when implementing AI, while recognising that larger and more context-specific studies are required to confirm this relationship.
zh_abstract: [Journal of Medical Imaging and Radiation Oncology] 职业倦怠是医疗行业各专业的主要关切，放射科医生和放射肿瘤科医生是受影响最严重的群体之一。人工智能（AI）有潜力通过减少工作量来降低职业倦怠；然而，先前研究显示 AI 使用与职业倦怠之间的关联不一致。这些关系可能取决于临床医生使用 AI 的动机。一项时长6.5分钟的匿名在线调查在2个月期间（2025年5月至7月）发放给澳大利亚和新西兰放射学家皇家学院（RANZCR）成员。测量指标包括人口统计学和工作相关变量（工作时间、培训水平）、职业倦怠、AI 使用（频率和任务类型）以及使用 AI 的动机（基于自我决定理论（Self-Determination Theory））。动机被检验为 AI 使用与职业倦怠之间关系的调节变量。收到121名临床医生的回复（90名放射科医生、31名放射肿瘤科医生），其中包括21名培训学员。42.1%（51/121）的受访者报告了临床显著职业倦怠。91名（75.2%）受访者报告使用 AI，主要用于图像分析和解读（放射科医生）以及治疗计划（放射肿瘤科医生）。AI 使用与职业倦怠之间总体上无显著关系。然而，在报告 AI 使用自主性较低者中，AI 使用与职业倦怠呈正相关。该关系并非由需求满足或需求受挫所中介。AI 使用在 RANZCR 成员中很常见，职业倦怠率也较普遍。这些初步发现凸显了在实施 AI 时支持自主性动机的潜在重要性，同时认识到需要更大规模、更具情境特异性的研究来确认这一关系。

title: Artificial intelligence as a precision diagnostic tool in gastrointestinal pathology.
zh_title: AI作为胃肠道病理精准诊断工具的综述

abstract: [Histopathology] Personalized medicine is on the rise, leading to increasingly granular treatment options. Consequently, pathologists are required to provide more detailed diagnoses to fully use the potential of these novel therapies. The number and complexity of grading systems and biomarker scoring methods are increasing. At the same time, the resulting rise in workload coincides with a growing shortage of pathologists, highlighting the need for new methods to ensure high-quality patient care in the future. This review explores the feasibility and readiness of artificial intelligence (AI) applications to alleviate routine diagnostic tasks in gastrointestinal (GI) pathology. It provides an organ-by-organ overview of both non-neoplastic and neoplastic diseases, with an emphasis on tools that show promise for direct or near-term clinical implementation. We found that numerous studies have investigated a wide range of diagnostic challenges, many of which have yielded encouraging results. While most tools remain in the research phase and often lack multicentre validation, commercially available AI solutions already exist for certain applications, in some cases even with regulatory approval for routine diagnostic use. In conclusion, most AI applications in GI pathology are still at a relatively early stage, and several challenges remain to be addressed. Nevertheless, many studies report promising results and suggest substantial advances in the near future. These developments have the potential to benefit both pathologists and patients by significantly expanding diagnostic capabilities while improving accuracy and reproducibility.
zh_abstract: [组织病理学] 个性化医疗正在兴起，带来越来越细化的治疗选择。因此，病理学家需要提供更详细的诊断，以充分利用这些新型疗法的潜力。分级系统和生物标志物评分方法的数量和复杂性正在增加。与此同时，由此导致的工作量上升恰逢病理学家日益短缺，凸显了对新方法的需求，以确保未来高质量的患者照护。本综述探讨了人工智能（AI）应用在减轻胃肠道（GI）病理常规诊断任务方面的可行性和准备程度。它按器官逐一概述了非肿瘤性和肿瘤性疾病，重点介绍那些显示出直接或近期临床实施前景的工具。我们发现，大量研究调查了广泛的诊断挑战，其中许多研究已取得令人鼓舞的结果。尽管大多数工具仍处于研究阶段，且往往缺乏多中心验证，但某些应用已有市售AI解决方案，部分甚至已获得常规诊断使用的监管批准。总之，GI病理学中的大多数AI应用仍处于相对早期阶段，仍有若干挑战需要解决。尽管如此，许多研究报告了有前景的结果，并提示近期将取得实质性进展。这些发展有可能通过显著扩展诊断能力，同时提高准确性和可重复性，使病理学家和患者均受益。

summary: 单中心回顾性研究比较AI与外科医生生成的术前模板与实际植入假体尺寸的一致性，纳入349例全髋与390例全膝置换。

abstract: [European journal of orthopaedic surgery & traumatology : orthopedie traumatologie] Artificial intelligence (AI) applications have become widely accessible resources, and the race is on to determine the safe application of this technology within total joint arthroplasty (TJA). One area of investigation is the use of AI with in preoperative templating for total hip (THA) and total knee arthroplasty (TKA). This study aimed to compare the accordance of AI- and surgeon-generated templates to the implants utilized in consecutive TJA cases. A retrospective review was performed of 349 THA and 390 TKA cases from a single academic arthroplasty practice between March 2025 and October 2025. Preoperative radiographs were evaluated to produce AI- and surgeon-generated THA templates for cup and stem size, which were compared to components implanted. For TKA, AI-generated template was compared to implanted femoral, tibial, and patellar components. Analysis was performed using mixed-effects models with a random intercept for surgeons, with Holm-adjusted two-tailed significance set at α = 0.05. For THA, surgeon and AI-generated templates overestimated cup (p < 0.0001) and stem (p < 0.0001) size. Surgeon-templated stem sizes were utilized in 30.1% of cases, making surgeon more frequently accurate than AI (22.4%; p = 0.02). Surgeon and AI-templated cup sizes were utilized in 35.8% and 29.8% of cases, respectively, which was not a statistically significant difference (p = 0.09). Compared with the actual implants utilized in TKA, AI tended to oversize femoral, tibial, and patella components. Artificial intelligence templating predicted implanted femoral and tibial size within two sizes in 85.9% and 84.4% of cases, respectfully, and predicted patella size within three millimeters in 92.6% of cases. AI-generated TJA templating software appears to overestimate component sizing and for THA templating does not outperform surgeons in evaluated metrics. While such technology shows promise in aiding in the preoperative templating workflow, refinement is necessary before integration into clinical practice.
zh_abstract: 【《欧洲骨科手术与创伤学杂志：骨科创伤学》】人工智能（AI）应用已成为广泛可及的资源，确定该技术在人工关节置换术（TJA）中安全应用的竞赛正在进行。一个研究领域是使用AI进行全髋关节置换术（THA）和全膝关节置换术（TKA）的术前模板规划。本研究旨在比较AI生成和外科医生生成的模板与连续TJA病例中所用植入物的一致性。对2025年3月至2025年10月期间单一学术关节置换实践中349例THA和390例TKA病例进行了回顾性回顾。评估术前X线片以生成AI和外科医生生成的THA髋臼杯及股骨柄尺寸模板，并与植入组件进行比较。对于TKA，将AI生成的模板与植入的股骨、胫骨和髌骨组件进行比较。分析使用以术者为随机截距的混合效应模型，Holm校正的双侧显著性设为α = 0.05。对于THA，外科医生和AI生成的模板均高估了髋臼杯（p < 0.0001）和股骨柄（p < 0.0001）尺寸。外科医生模板化的股骨柄尺寸在30.1%的病例中被使用，使外科医生比AI更常准确（22.4%；p = 0.02）。外科医生和AI模板化的髋臼杯尺寸分别在35.8%和29.8%的病例中被使用，差异无统计学意义（p = 0.09）。与TKA中实际使用的植入物相比，AI倾向于高估股骨、胫骨和髌骨组件尺寸。AI模板在85.9%和84.4%的病例中分别在两个尺寸以内预测植入的股骨和胫骨尺寸，并在92.6%的病例中在三毫米以内预测髌骨尺寸。AI生成的TJA模板软件似乎高估组件尺寸，并且在THA模板规划中，在所评估指标上并未优于外科医生。虽然此类技术在辅助术前模板规划工作流程方面显示出前景，但在整合到临床实践之前仍需改进。

abstract: Growing the recent advances in artificial intelligence and machine leaning (AI&ML) approaches accelerated small molecules screening against targeted proteins with limited computational resources and time. Finding accurate binding pose and affinity prediction is challenges task and traditional docking tools and lacks the reproducibility. Development of the Co-folding model is paradigm shift in drug discovery and development, allowing to predict protein ligand complexes without experimental crystal structures. Notably Boltz-2 predicts the complex structure along with binding affinity directly using protein FASTA sequence and ligand SMILES. Our previous studies confirmed that Boltz-2 is classify binder non-binders effectively. Autodock Vina and GNINA are widely used docking with knowledge and CNN based scoring functions allows to screen potential small molecules. We developed in-house VS-suite (Virtual Screening Suite) multi-environment conda orchestration designed to automate the docking workflow only using FASTA and SMILES string as inputs via streamlit-based browser GUI which integrates the boltz-2 for the complex structure prediction followed docking using AutoDock Vina for Gnina. Validation on 58 antiviral nucleoside analogues screened against SARS-CoV-2 main protease (Mpro). VS-Suite is available at https://github.com/Vsubuchem-lab/Virtual-screening-suite-VS-Suite. This consensus approaches helpful in rapid screening of small molecules against selected targets. The findings and VS-suite support its utility as a rapid and reliable tool for hit identification and rational drug development.
zh_abstract: 人工智能和机器学习（AI&ML）方法的最新进展加速了在有限计算资源和时间内针对靶蛋白的小分子筛选。找到准确的结合构象和亲和力预测是一项具有挑战性的任务，传统对接工具缺乏可重复性。共折叠（Co-folding）模型的发展是药物发现与开发中的范式转变，使得无需实验晶体结构即可预测蛋白质-配体复合物。值得注意的是，Boltz-2直接使用蛋白质FASTA序列和配体SMILES预测复合物结构及结合亲和力。我们之前的研究证实，Boltz-2能有效分类结合物和非结合物。AutoDock Vina和GNINA是广泛使用的对接工具，具有基于知识和CNN的评分函数，可筛选潜在小分子。我们开发了内部VS-suite（Virtual Screening Suite）多环境conda编排，旨在仅通过基于Streamlit的浏览器GUI，以FASTA和SMILES字符串作为输入来自动化对接工作流；该GUI集成了Boltz-2用于复合物结构预测，随后使用AutoDock Vina进行GNINA对接。在58个抗病毒核苷类似物针对SARS-CoV-2主蛋白酶（Mpro）的筛选中进行了验证。VS-Suite可在https://github.com/Vsubuchem-lab/Virtual-screening-suite-VS-Suite获取。这种共识方法有助于针对选定靶标快速筛选小分子。研究结果和VS-suite支持其作为命中识别和合理药物开发中快速可靠工具的实用性。

title: CellTouch: Learning to separate touching nuclei in anisotropic 3D cell cultures
zh_title: CellTouch：分离各向异性3D细胞培养中相互接触的细胞核
summary: 预印本提出深度学习3D细胞核实例分割方法，以流场与接触通道分离粘连细胞核，优于现有方法。
key_points: 面向类器官/球体Z轴采样各向异性问题
消融显示接触通道为关键设计
内部与公开数据优于现有方法；预印本
reason: 方法有消融与公开数据对比，但属未经同行评审预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: 3D-oids, such as spheroids and organoids, are essential models in drug discovery and precision medicine, and quantitative analysis requires every nucleus to be segmented separately. Accurate 3D instance segmentation remains challenging, because nuclei are densely packed and touching, and volumes are sampled more coarsely along the Z-axis than laterally. Most existing methods were developed for near-isotropic data and tend to merge neighbouring nuclei. To address this challenge, we propose CellTouch, a deep learning method for anisotropic 3D nuclei instance segmentation that predicts flow fields and a contact channel, which separates touching nuclei directly from the network output. Ablations showed that the contact channel is the key design element, and CellTouch outperformed state-of-the-art methods on in-house data and widely used public datasets. Most importantly, dense Z-sampling is not required: CellTouch segmented nuclei as accurately at a 2 um Z-step as at 0.5 um, reducing acquisition time and data volume four-fold.
zh_abstract: 3D类器官（3D-oids），如球状体和类器官，是药物发现和精准医学中的重要模型，定量分析需要分别分割每一个细胞核。准确的3D实例分割仍然具有挑战性，因为细胞核密集排列且相互接触，并且体积沿Z轴的采样比横向更粗糙。大多数现有方法是针对接近各向同性的数据开发的，往往会合并相邻细胞核。为应对这一挑战，我们提出CellTouch，一种用于各向异性3D细胞核实例分割的深度学习方法，它预测流场和接触通道，从而直接从网络输出中分离相互接触的细胞核。消融实验表明，接触通道是关键设计要素，并且CellTouch在内部数据和广泛使用的公共数据集上优于最先进方法。最重要的是，不需要密集Z采样：CellTouch在2 um Z步长下分割细胞核的准确性与0.5 um下一样，将采集时间和数据量减少了四倍。

abstract: Background: Fungi are important pathogens and biotechnology resources, but lack a broadly applicable fungal DNA language model. Models trained on diverse fungal genomes can support functional interpretation of genomic variants and a broad range of genomic tasks. Results: We introduce FunDLM, a family of four DNA language models pre-trained on 426 fungal reference assemblies spanning 217 genera and 14.3 Gb of sequence. Without task-specific training, FunDLM-Medium-1024bp distinguished phenotype-associated missense variants of Saccharomyces cerevisiae from synonymous controls with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.875. It performed comparably to Evo 2, a generalist model with about 15 times more parameters, and better than Nucleotide Transformer v3. The model also recognized mutations that disrupt start codons or introduce premature stop codons in S. cerevisiae and the blast fungus Pyricularia oryzae. Its scores for missense variants, computed from DNA alone, correlated with those of protein language models in S. cerevisiae and two Fusarium species (Pearson correlation 0.57-0.75). After fine-tuning, FunDLM-Small-1024bp identified supernumerary chromosome sequences in four Pyricularia isolates not used for training (average precision 0.884), and FunDLM-Medium-1024bp recognized centromeres on a chromosome withheld from training (AUROC 0.908). Fine-tuned models also predicted three histone modifications in an isolate and on chromosomes not used for training (AUROC 0.910-0.996). Conclusions: FunDLM provides reusable sequence representations for assessing functional impacts of fungal variants as well as annotation of genomic and epigenomic features. The released models, data, code, and benchmarks support applications across fungal species.
zh_abstract: 【背景】真菌是重要病原体和生物技术资源，但缺乏广泛适用的真菌DNA语言模型。在多样化真菌基因组上训练的模型可支持基因组变异的功能解释以及广泛的基因组任务。【结果】我们推出FunDLM，这是一个由四个DNA语言模型组成的模型家族，基于426个真菌参考组装序列（覆盖217个属和14.3 Gb序列）预训练。在无需任务特异性训练的情况下，FunDLM-Medium-1024bp将酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）中与表型相关的错义变异与同义对照区分开来，受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为0.875。其表现与参数约多15倍的通用模型Evo 2相当，并优于Nucleotide Transformer v3。该模型还识别出在酿酒酵母和稻瘟病菌（Pyricularia oryzae）中破坏起始密码子或引入提前终止密码子的突变。其仅基于DNA计算的错义变异评分与酿酒酵母和两个镰刀菌属（Fusarium）物种中蛋白质语言模型的评分相关（Pearson相关系数0.57–0.75）。经过微调后，FunDLM-Small-1024bp识别出四个未用于训练的Pyricularia分离株中的超数染色体序列（平均精度0.884），FunDLM-Medium-1024bp在一条未用于训练的染色体上识别出着丝粒（AUROC 0.908）。微调后的模型还在一个分离株中以及未用于训练的染色体上预测了三种组蛋白修饰（AUROC 0.910–0.996）。【结论】FunDLM为评估真菌变异的功能影响以及注释基因组和表观基因组特征提供了可复用的序列表示。已发布的模型、数据、代码和基准支持跨真菌物种的应用。

title: Distance-stratified benchmarking of variant-effect predictors on β-lactamase deep mutational scanning data
zh_title: 变异效应预测器按位点距离分层基准评测
summary: 用β-内酰胺酶深度突变扫描数据，比较ESM2、结构稳定性预测器随催化位点距离变化的性能。
key_points: ESM2在TEM-1远端位点相关性明显下降
加入稳定性分数对远端位点提升更明显
基于TEM-1四组与VIM-2一组实验数据
reason: 预印本基准分析，方法清晰但证据限于计算评测，属值得一看档。
abstract: Mutations far from the active site of antibiotic-resistance enzymes can change resistance, but it is unclear what information predicts their effects. We asked how the performance of a protein language model (ESM2), a structure-based stability predictor (ThermoMPNN) and simple structural descriptors changes with distance from the catalytic residues, using deep mutational scanning data for the {beta}-lactamases TEM-1 (four assays) and VIM-2 (one assay). We measured Spearman correlation and AUROC within distance bins, with bootstrap intervals over positions. In TEM-1, ESM2 accuracy fell with distance (Stiffler assay: {rho} = 0.72 below 8 [A] and 0.42 beyond 20 [A]), while the stability score rose ({rho} = 0.41 to 0.70). Adding stability to a model of ESM2, solvent accessibility and neighbour count improved cross-validated {rho} by 0.02 below 8 [A] and 0.10 beyond 20 [A], and the combined model did not decline with distance. The pattern held across binning schemes, in a continuous-distance model, and when any one of five contiguous distal stretches was removed. Two TEM-1 assays are nearly duplicates, and the Deng assay was too noisy to be informative. VIM-2 has only seven positions beyond 20 [A] and showed no detectable trend within 20 [A], so it neither supports nor contradicts the TEM-1 pattern. Nine distal TEM-1 positions remained more sensitive than the models predicted. In TEM-1, predicted stability was more informative than the language model far from the catalytic site, and the language model was stronger near it. Distance-stratified reporting could add to variant-effect benchmarks. The study is exploratory and uses one structure and one phenotype per assay.
zh_abstract: 远离抗生素耐药酶活性位点的突变可改变耐药性，但目前尚不清楚哪些信息能够预测其效应。我们利用 β-内酰胺酶 TEM-1（四项测定）和 VIM-2（一项测定）的深度突变扫描数据，考察了蛋白质语言模型（ESM2）、基于结构的稳定性预测器（ThermoMPNN）以及简单结构描述符的性能如何随与催化残基距离的变化而变化。我们在距离分箱内测量 Spearman 相关系数和 AUROC，并对位置进行 bootstrap 区间估计。在 TEM-1 中，ESM2 的准确性随距离下降（Stiffler 测定：低于 8 [A] 时 ρ = 0.72，超过 20 [A] 时 ρ = 0.42），而稳定性评分上升（ρ = 0.41 至 0.70）。将稳定性加入由 ESM2、溶剂可及性和邻居数量构成的模型后，交叉验证 ρ 在低于 8 [A] 时提高 0.02，在超过 20 [A] 时提高 0.10，且联合模型未随距离下降。该模式在不同分箱方案、连续距离模型以及去除五个连续远端区段中任一个时均成立。两项 TEM-1 测定几乎为重复，Deng 测定噪声太大而无法提供有用信息。VIM-2 在超过 20 [A] 处仅有 7 个位置，且在 20 [A] 以内未显示可检测趋势，因此既不能支持也不能反驳 TEM-1 的模式。九个远端 TEM-1 位置仍比模型预测的更敏感。在 TEM-1 中，远离催化位点时预测稳定性比语言模型提供的信息更多，而在催化位点附近语言模型更强。按距离分层报告可补充变异效应基准。本研究为探索性研究，每种测定使用一个结构和一种表型。

title: Task-aligned foundation model representations enable single-cell cytokine response inference
zh_title: 任务对齐基础模型表征推断单细胞细胞因子应答
summary: 提出CYTAP，基于冷冻单细胞基础模型嵌入与对照基线偏差，推断90种细胞因子的单细胞应答。
key_points: 以对照质心偏差构建相对应答表征
在独立扰动数据集中优先命中实际施加因子
两套体内数据集进入前十，含非配对COVID队列
reason: 预印本新方法，多套独立数据验证但无临床应用，属值得一看档。
abstract: Inferring cellular responses from single-cell transcriptomes requires interpreting changes relative to an appropriate baseline while retaining cell-type context. Here we present CYTAP, which adapts frozen single-cell foundation model embeddings for cytokine-response inference by combining donor-adjusted receiver states with deviations from matched control centroids. CYTAP uses a shared classifier to assign relative single-cell response scores across 90 cytokines and supports unpaired analyses using counterfactual control references. Baseline-relative representations improved held-out-donor prediction with both State SE and scFoundation. Across independent perturbation datasets, CYTAP prioritized applied cytokines, including when receptor transcripts were sparsely detected, and ranked administered cytokines among the top ten in both in vivo datasets. In an unpaired COVID-19 cohort, inferred responses were associated with severity, and IL-6 response scores correlated with plasma IL-6 concentrations. These findings support the use of biologically defined references to adapt pretrained representations for functional response inference.
zh_abstract: 从单细胞转录组推断细胞反应，需要相对于适当基线解释变化，同时保留细胞类型背景。在此，我们提出 CYTAP，它通过将供者校正的接收状态与相对于匹配对照质心的偏差相结合，使冻结的单细胞基础模型嵌入适配于细胞因子反应推断。CYTAP 使用共享分类器为 90 种细胞因子分配相对单细胞反应评分，并支持使用反事实对照参考进行非配对分析。相对于基线的表征在 State SE 和 scFoundation 中均改善了留出供者预测。在独立扰动数据集中，CYTAP 优先识别所施加的细胞因子，包括在受体转录本检测稀疏时；并且在两个体内数据集中均将给药的细胞因子排在前十。在一个非配对 COVID-19 队列中，推断的反应与严重程度相关，且 IL-6 反应评分与血浆 IL-6 浓度相关。这些发现支持使用生物学定义的参考来适配预训练表征，以进行功能反应推断。

title: HapAdapter: A Transfer Learning Protocol for DNA Foundation Models Adapted to Diploid Personal Epigenomes
zh_title: HapAdapter：适配二倍体个人表观基因组的DNA基础模型迁移学习方案
summary: 预印本提出HapAdapter迁移学习协议，使仅基于单倍体参考基因组训练的DNA基础模型可适配个人二倍体表观基因组。
key_points: 现有DNA基础模型均在单倍体参考基因组上训练
个人二倍体基因组训练成本高，难以按个体实施
以迁移学习协议衔接现有模型与现代基因组分析需求
reason: 方法学预印本具新意，但摘要未给出验证规模与对照结果
abstract: The rapid rise of large language models (LLMs) has spurred the development of genomic language models (gLMs) that capitalize on the key features of natural language present in biological sequences. Moreover, DNA foundation models, a sub-class of gLMs, have demonstrated impressive accuracy in predicting a wide range of functional tracks from DNA sequence input. However, current DNA foundation models are exclusively trained on haploid reference genome sequences -- despite personal and graph genomes becoming the new standard for genomic analyses. This is principally because the cost to train gLMs on a personal diploid genome for a single individual is not currently practical. To help reconcile this disconnect between the current available use-cases of DNA foundation models with the modern direction of genomic sequence analysis, we present HapAdapter, a transfer-learning protocol that builds a small Siamese network on top of any pre-trained foundation model to enable inference from full diploid personal genome context. To demonstrate the utility of this method, we train a set of HapAdapter heads to predict allele-specific effects across assays on two representative foundation model backbones: DNABERT-2 and AlphaGenome. We demonstrate that our lightweight adapter more than doubles DNABERT-2's allele-specific discrimination and triples AlphaGenome's (130% and 210% gain in AUROC above chance, respectively, averaged over nine assays).
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）的迅速兴起推动了基因组语言模型（gLMs）的发展，这类模型利用生物序列中存在的自然语言关键特征。此外，作为 gLMs 的一个子类，DNA 基础模型已证明在从 DNA 序列输入预测广泛功能轨迹方面具有令人印象深刻的准确性。然而，当前的 DNA 基础模型仅基于单倍体参考基因组序列进行训练——尽管个人基因组和图基因组正成为基因组分析的新标准。这主要是因为目前对单个个体在个人二倍体基因组上训练 gLMs 的成本并不实际。为帮助弥合 DNA 基础模型当前可用应用场景与基因组序列分析的现代方向之间的这一脱节，我们提出 HapAdapter，一种迁移学习协议，它在任何预训练基础模型之上构建一个小型孪生网络（Siamese network），以支持从完整二倍体个人基因组背景进行推断。为证明该方法的实用性，我们在两个代表性基础模型骨干 DNABERT-2 和 AlphaGenome 上训练一组 HapAdapter 预测头，以预测跨检测的等位基因特异性效应。我们证明，我们的轻量级适配器使 DNABERT-2 的等位基因特异性区分能力提高超过一倍，并使 AlphaGenome 的提高两倍（在九项检测中平均，AUROC 相对于随机水平的增益分别为 130% 和 210%）。

title: Capturing human expertise for AI-assisted molecular structure annotation

abstract: We developed a large language model-based tool that captures expert reasoning in bile acid structure elucidation, drawing on hand written notebooks, scientific literature, and recorded voice-to-text analytical sessions. It generates human-readable reports detailing evidence for and against candidate structures, tracing each inference to its source and identifying ambiguities. When applied to data, the tool proposes bile acid conjugates lacking reference spectra.
zh_abstract: 我们开发了一种基于大语言模型的工具，用于在胆汁酸结构解析中捕捉专家推理，其依据包括手写笔记本、科学文献以及录制的语音转文字分析会话。该工具生成人类可读的报告，详细说明支持或反对候选结构的证据，将每一项推断追溯至其来源，并识别歧义。应用于数据时，该工具可提出缺乏参考谱图的胆汁酸结合物。

title: rnaModScan: context-aware deep learning-based filtering of nanopore m6A and inosine calls
zh_title: rnaModScan：基于深度学习的纳米孔m6A与肌苷位点过滤
summary: 预印本提出整合Dorado打分与序列、重复、比对特征的深度学习过滤器，用于剔除纳米孔直接RNA测序中m6A与肌苷的假阳性候选。
key_points: 针对八类修饰的Dorado打分构建过滤模型
分组五折交叉验证评估位点分类
权重仅用HEK293T数据训练后迁移至HeLa
非DRACH基序m6A剔除92.85%候选，保留93.34%参考匹配
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，含跨细胞系迁移评估，但为未经同行评审的有限证据档
abstract: Nanopore direct RNA sequencing (DRS) can detect multiple RNA modifications, but falsepositive background calls complicate transcriptome-wide analysis. We developed rnaModScan,a deep learning filter that integrates Dorado scores for all eight modification types with local sequence, repeat, and per-read alignment features to distinguish N6-methyladenosine (m6A) and inosine candidates from background calls. Using public RNA004 data, we evaluated site classification by grouped five-fold cross-validation and assessed transfer to HeLa cellular RNA using model weights fitted exclusively to HEK293T cellular RNA and unmodified in vitrotranscribed controls. For m6A sites outside the canonical DRACH motif, filtering removed 92.85% of the Dorado/modkit candidates while retaining 93.34% of their original matches to the GLORI reference map. The F1 score relative to DRS-covered GLORI sites increased from 3.04% to 26.76%. For inosine, filtering removed 83.44% of the candidates while preserving 99.86% of their original Slic-seq matches, and the reference-map F1 score increased from 5.22% to 22.05%. Filtering also brought the motif, repeat, and transcript-position distributions of retained candidates closer to those in the orthogonal short-read maps generated by GLORI and Slic-seq. These results support rnaModScan as a practical complement to Dorado-based RNA004 analysis for prioritizing transcriptome-wide m6A and inosine candidates.Availability: rnaModScan is available at https://github.com/uedaLabR/rnaModScan and archived in Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24546829).Keywords: direct RNA sequencing; RNA modifications; Dorado; deep learning; inosine; m6A
zh_abstract: 纳米孔直接 RNA 测序（DRS）可检测多种 RNA 修饰，但假阳性背景判定使全转录组分析复杂化。我们开发了 rnaModScan，一种深度学习过滤器，它整合全部八种修饰类型的 Dorado 分数与局部序列、重复序列和每条读段比对特征，以将 N6-甲基腺苷（m6A）和肌苷（inosine）候选与背景判定区分开。使用公开 RNA004 数据，我们通过分组五折交叉验证评估位点分类，并使用仅基于 HEK293T 细胞 RNA 和未修饰体外转录对照拟合的模型权重，评估向 HeLa 细胞 RNA 的迁移。对于经典 DRACH 基序之外的 m6A 位点，过滤去除了 92.85% 的 Dorado/modkit 候选，同时保留了其与 GLORI 参考图谱原始匹配的 93.34%。相对于 DRS 覆盖的 GLORI 位点的 F1 分数从 3.04% 提高到 26.76%。对于肌苷，过滤去除了 83.44% 的候选，同时保留了其原始 Slic-seq 匹配的 99.86%，参考图谱 F1 分数从 5.22% 提高到 22.05%。过滤还使保留候选的基序、重复序列和转录本位置分布更接近 GLORI 和 Slic-seq 生成的正交短读长图谱中的分布。这些结果支持 rnaModScan 作为基于 Dorado 的 RNA004 分析的实用补充，用于对全转录组 m6A 和肌苷候选进行优先级排序。可用性：rnaModScan 可在 https://github.com/uedaLabR/rnaModScan 获取，并归档于 Zenodo（https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24546829）。关键词：直接 RNA 测序；RNA 修饰；Dorado；深度学习；肌苷；m6A。

title: LifeLine.ai: A SigLIP-MedGemma Multimodal Framework with KTO Alignment for Open-Vocabulary 12-Lead ECG Report Generation
zh_title: LifeLine.ai：多模态十二导联心电图报告生成框架
summary: 预印本提出视觉-心电-语言多模态框架，基于MIMIC-IV与PTB-XL数据子集生成心电图报告并支持问答。
key_points: 结合SigLIP与MedGemma，使用KTO对齐
基于MIMIC-IV与PTB-XL平衡子集
预印本，未经同行评审
reason: 有新意的多模态生成预印本，但仅子集评估、无外部验证，属值得一看档
abstract: Automated twelve-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) interpretation has historically relied on discriminative classifiers limited to closed-set diagnostic labels, signal reconstruction, or saliency heatmaps. While categorizing predefined arrhythmias well, these static classifiers cannot generate narrative clinical reports, incorporate patient history, or support interactive clinical question-answering (Q&A). We present LifeLine.ai, an end-toend multimodal Vision-ECG-Language framework for automated cardiac diagnosis and clinical reporting. After early attempts at waveform peak-tracking and coordinate mapping failed against complex morphological variations, we leveraged large-scale PhysioNet repositories (MIMIC-IV and PTB-XL). Because hardware limits precluded training on over 800,000 raw records, we curated a balanced subset to estimate performance, converting one-dimensional signals into 3x4 twelve-lead grids with continuous Lead II rhythm strips at the bottom. Our pipeline integrates YOLOv11s localization, a LoRAadapted Google SigLIP encoder, a trainable Multi-Layer Perceptron projector, and a 4-bit quantized MedGemma-4B model, complemented by a separate Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (KTO) pipeline built on collected user feedback and a multi-LLM consensus engine. On this compact subset, SigLIP outperformed Swin Transformer encodings (~0.21 vs. ~0.25 validation loss), achieving 71.0% open-vocabulary precision and a 75.0% contextual F1 score across a cloud deployment spanning Vercel, mobile apps, Amazon EC2, Firebase, Hugging Face, Modal GPUs, and lifelinecg-sdk. Our code is available at https://github.com/Asad939asad/ LifeLine.ai-.
zh_abstract: 自动十二导联心电图（ECG）解读历来依赖于判别式分类器，这些分类器局限于闭集诊断标签、信号重建或显著性热图。这些静态分类器虽然能很好地对预定义心律失常进行分类，但不能生成叙述性临床报告、纳入患者病史或支持交互式临床问答（Q&A）。我们提出LifeLine.ai，一个端到端多模态视觉-ECG-语言框架，用于自动心脏诊断和临床报告。在早期尝试波形峰值追踪和坐标映射因复杂形态变化而失败后，我们利用了大规模PhysioNet数据库（MIMIC-IV和PTB-XL）。由于硬件限制无法在超过800,000条原始记录上进行训练，我们策划了一个平衡子集来估计性能，将一维信号转换为3x4十二导联网格，并在底部附有连续II导联节律条。我们的流程集成了YOLOv11s定位、LoRA适配的Google SigLIP编码器、可训练的多层感知机投影器以及4位量化的MedGemma-4B模型，并辅以一个单独的Kahneman-Tversky优化（KTO）流程，该流程建立在收集的用户反馈和多LLM共识引擎之上。在这个紧凑子集上，SigLIP优于Swin Transformer编码（验证损失约0.21 vs. 约0.25），在跨越Vercel、移动应用、Amazon EC2、Firebase、Hugging Face、Modal GPUs和lifelinecg-sdk的云部署中，实现了71.0%的开放词汇精确率和75.0%的上下文F1分数。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Asad939asad/ LifeLine.ai-获取。

abstract: [Seminars in fetal & neonatal medicine] Neonatal brain injury remains a major contributor to mortality and long-term neurodevelopmental disability worldwide. Over the past two decades, neonatal neurocritical care (NNCC) has emerged as an interdisciplinary model focused on early diagnosis, continuous neuromonitoring, and neuroprotective interventions. Digital health technologies are now accelerating this transformation by expanding access to specialized expertise, enabling remote neuromonitoring, and supporting more standardized and individualized care across geographically distributed neonatal intensive care units (NICUs). This review discusses the evolving roles of telemedicine, multimodal monitoring, immersive technologies, artificial intelligence, and digital data ecosystems in NNCC. We explore current clinical applications, implementation challenges, and future perspectives, including precision neuroprotection, predictive analysis, and longitudinal digital neuro-NICU models. By integrating these technologies, digitally connected NNCC may help shift the field from reactive treatment of established injury toward proactive, precision-based neuroprotection focused on lifelong brain health.
zh_abstract: 《Seminars in Fetal & Neonatal Medicine》新生儿脑损伤仍然是全球死亡和长期神经发育残疾的主要原因。过去二十年中，新生儿神经重症监护（NNCC）作为一种跨学科模式出现，重点关注早期诊断、持续神经监测和神经保护干预。数字健康技术现正通过扩大专业知识的可及性、实现远程神经监测，并支持在地理上分散的新生儿重症监护病房（NICUs）中提供更标准化和个体化的照护，加速这一转变。本综述讨论远程医疗、多模态监测、沉浸式技术、人工智能和数字数据生态系统在 NNCC 中不断演变的作用。我们探讨当前的临床应用、实施挑战和未来前景，包括精准神经保护、预测分析和纵向数字神经-NICU 模式。通过整合这些技术，数字连接的新生儿神经重症监护可能有助于推动该领域从对已确立损伤的反应性治疗，转向以终身脑健康为重点的主动性、基于精准的神经保护。

Prior to surgery, doctors attempt to anticipate the risk of complications using information about a patient's current health, lifestyle, and medical records. The more useful health information doctors have, the more accurately they can predict whether someone is likely to develop a complication. New technology, such as wearables (e.g., smartwatches), which are widely available and frequently used by the general public, can provide detailed health information outside of the immediate clinical environment, such as heart rate, steps taken/distance walked in a day, and sleep quality. All participants in both phases of the study will be asked to wear the device for 48 hours in the 3 months before their scheduled surgery.

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: IRCCS Ospedale San Raffaele; conditions: Breast Cancer; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 1500; status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING] The goal of this observational study is to evaluate artificial intelligence (AI) models that automatically outline the target area for radiotherapy, called the clinical target volume (CTV), in adult women treated with whole-breast radiotherapy for breast cancer. Outlining this area by hand is time-consuming and can differ between doctors and between hospitals. The main questions it aims to answer are: 1. How closely do AI-generated outlines agree with outlines approved by doctors, including in patients from hospitals not used to build the models? 2. How much do outlines vary within and between hospitals, and can AI help quantify and reduce this variability? 3. Which methods work best to build probability maps, which show for each point of the image how likely it is to belong to the target area? Researchers will use planning CT images and target outlines already collected during routine care at eight Italian hospitals, in fully anonymized form. No new tests or treatments are performed and patients are not contacted. AI models will be developed and tested on these data and compared with the contours used for treatment and with a subset drawn independently by several expert radiation oncologists on the same images in one/more institutes. The results are intended to support quality assurance, professional training and standardization of breast radiotherapy within the Italian National Health Service, including the development of a web-based educational platform for breast radiotherapy contouring.

abstract: [Seminars in fetal & neonatal medicine] Congenital anomalies affect approximately 3 to 5% of all pregnancies and represent a leading cause of infant morbidity and mortality worldwide. When a fetal malformation is detected on mid-trimester anatomic ultrasound, the clinical encounter that follows is not merely a medical consultation. It is an ethically charged event requiring the clinician to simultaneously respect maternal autonomy, apply beneficence-based clinical judgment, and, after viability, fulfill obligations to the fetal patient as well. This article applies the professional responsibility model, grounded in the ethics of medicine as a profession developed by John Gregory and Thomas Percival, to the counseling process following prenatal detection of a fetal anomaly. The model requires physicians to maintain scientific and clinical competence, to place the health-related interests of both patients as their primary concern, and to preserve medicine as a public trust. Within this framework, autonomy, beneficence, and justice each impose specific obligations, and a preventive ethics approach demands that clinicians anticipate and address ethical conflict before it escalates. Large language models (LLMs) offer genuine capabilities to support these ethical obligations: personalizing diagnostic information, bridging language and health literacy barriers, and extending clinical support beyond the encounter itself. However, LLM-generated content should be clinician-reviewed before reaching patients, informed consent processes should disclose AI involvement, and implementation should actively address equity across care settings. The physician's role as guide, interpreter, and compassionate presence cannot be delegated to any algorithmic system. With appropriate governance, LLMs amplify the art of counseling rather than replace it.
zh_abstract: [Seminars in fetal & neonatal medicine] 先天性畸形影响约3%至5%的所有妊娠，并且是全球婴儿发病和死亡的主要原因。当中孕期解剖超声发现胎儿畸形时，随后的临床接触不仅仅是一次医疗咨询。这是一个承载伦理意义的事件，要求临床医生同时尊重母亲自主权、应用基于有利原则的临床判断，并且在可存活后还要履行对胎儿患者的义务。本文将以John Gregory和Thomas Percival发展起来的医学作为一门专业的伦理学为基础的职业责任模型（professional responsibility model），应用于产前发现胎儿畸形后的咨询过程。该模型要求医生保持科学和临床胜任力，将两名患者（both patients）的健康相关利益作为首要关注，并维护医学作为公共信任。在此框架内，自主、有利和正义各自施加特定义务，而预防性伦理方法要求临床医生在伦理冲突升级之前预见并处理它。大语言模型（LLMs）提供了真实的能力来支持这些伦理义务：个性化诊断信息、弥合语言和健康素养障碍，并将临床支持延伸到会面本身之外。然而，LLM生成的内容在传达给患者之前应由临床医生审查，知情同意过程应披露AI参与，实施应积极处理不同照护环境中的公平性。医生作为引导者、解释者和富有同情心的在场者的角色不能委托给任何算法系统。在适当治理下，LLMs放大咨询的艺术而非取代它。

abstract: [The Libyan journal of medicine] Thoracic infections are deemed extraordinary cases that need to be detected early to improve their corresponding management. abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] Cutaneous lupus erythematosus (CLE) poses challenges in differential diagnosis, subtype classification, and longitudinal management because of its heterogeneous phenotypes and variable association with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). This narrative review evaluates artificial intelligence (AI) evidence by clinical task, data modality, disease relevance, and validation maturity. Direct CLE studies provide early evidence for image-based lesion and subtype classification, including a multicentre multimodal system that improved dermatologists' diagnostic accuracy. A separate proof-of-concept study used natural language processing (NLP) to estimate Cutaneous Lupus Erythematosus Disease Area and Severity Index (CLASI) activity and damage scores from physical-examination notes. This text-based result should not be interpreted as automated severity scoring from clinical photographs: image-based lesion segmentation and CLASI estimation remain proposed applications. CLE transcriptomic, single-cell, and spatial studies reveal subtype-related B-cell signatures, interferon-associated keratinocyte states, specialized fibroblasts, and altered cell-cell communication; these findings are biological foundations for future models rather than validated patient-level prediction systems. Across applications, the level of CLE relevance is distinct from the maturity of validation. Current limitations include small or incompletely characterized disease-specific subsets, inconsistent image acquisition, uncertain independence of test cohorts, and limited prospective assessment of clinical utility. Progress requires transparent reporting of CLE-specific denominators, patient-level data separation, independent external validation, calibration, pigmentation-aware subgroup assessment, and clinician-supervised prospective evaluation. AI should therefore be regarded as an investigational decision-support approach for CLE, with clinical benefit established through disease-specific testing.

abstract: Most existing methods for performing differential expression testing using single-cell RNA-seq data evaluate genes independently and primarily detect shifts in mean RNA levels. These methods may thus miss RNAs that distinguish experimental groups jointly or through changes in the shape of genes' expression distributions. To address this limitation, we developed RecurSieve, an iterative ensemble learning method that combines shared expression classification with unsupervised clustering to recursively identify gene sets with group-based expression differences. Because experimental labels apply to heterogeneous populations of single cells within each comparative group, RecurSieve allows dynamic label reassignment during iterative training to detect subtle, non-linear expression patterns. In benchmarking experiments using simulated data with staged distributional expression differences, RecurSieve recovered more genes (2.3-3.9 of 10 staged genes) across groups as compared to standard methods (Wilcoxon, t-test, and logistic regression; 0.0-0.7 staged genes). When applied to a single nuclei RNA-seq analysis containing low and high-pathology stages of Alzheimer's disease (46 human donor brains), RecurSieve extended results from standard approaches by identifying genes including WWOX, DPP10, KCNIP4, HS6ST3, and CNTN5 which tend to exhibit stage-specific distributional expression differences accompanied by only minor changes in average expression. A subset of the genes exclusively detected in RecurSieve analysis had been previously associated with Alzheimer's disease, underscoring the potential importance resulting from the unique sensitivity of our method. These simulated and empirical single-cell RNA-seq results demonstrate how the RecurSieve framework complements standard methods for identifying genes with unique group-specific expression differences independent of changes in average expression.
